ABOUT BUDDY COMPUTERS

Technology help
that comes to you.

Buddy Computers is an appointment-based computer, IT and digital service for customers across Ahmedabad.

OUR APPROACH

Understand the problem.
Make the solution useful.

Buddy Computers is built around a simple idea: technical help should be practical, clear and easy to access.

Instead of asking customers to find a shop and carry their system across the city, we arrange service at your home or workplace. If a device needs workshop-level work, we can arrange collection and return after the requirement is discussed.

Our work covers PC and laptop problems, custom builds and upgrades, office networking, website development and digital support. The common thread is the same—understand what you actually need before recommending what to do next.

HOW THE BUSINESS WORKS

No storefront.
More convenient service.

Buddy Computers operates online and by appointment. Customers connect through the website, phone or WhatsApp, and service is arranged around the job.

01

Connect online or by phone

Send the problem, device details or project requirement.

02

Site visit in Ahmedabad

We arrange a suitable visit to your home or workplace.

03

Repair, support or pickup

Work is completed on-site when suitable, or the system is collected if more detailed repair is needed.

04

Return & handover

For collected systems, the completed device is returned and the work is explained.
